mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) shows a positive Rank IC with 60-day returns, or the negative return signal fails in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets price in recession risks.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive more than 50% of the time despite FEDFUNDS rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing sector weakness foreshadows broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 5-day return when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * HOUST) shows a negative Rank IC with 60-day returns, or the positive return signal fails in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), rising wage pressures lead to higher corporate costs and inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate policy tightening.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the tight labor market condition, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive more than 50% of the time, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.
